name: Canada
dossier:
The Canada national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Les Rouges, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 27 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from CONCACAF to this expanded 48-team tournament.

Co-hosts with a rocket in Alphonso Davies and a point to prove after a winless 2022.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Canada will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group B and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group B. The connection between Alphonso Davies and Jonathan David is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Alphonso Davies - the clinical wing-back who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Canada are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Canada are co-hosting their first home World Cup and chasing a first-ever World Cup goal celebration on home soil with fans behind them.
Canada boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Group stage (1986, 2022).
